title: Durchsuchungen nach Brandanschlag im September 2025 auf Berliner Stromnetz

extraction.summaryEn: Police searched about 500 officers' worth of premises in Berlin, Hamburg, North Rhine-Westphalia and Brandenburg in connection with a September 2025 arson attack on two power pylons that caused a large blackout in Berlin. Four suspects aged 28 to 36 are investigated for suspected anti-constitutional sabotage.
